about.text: Pannónia Emmentaler is a Hungarian version of the Swiss Emmenthal cheese.

sources.text: Hungarian Emmental equivalent, sold as 'Ementáli' until 1981, renamed after a Swiss-Hungarian treaty; slightly nutty; ripening time not found
